title: Print each list item
description:
Declare a function named print_list. It takes a list as a parameter and it prints out each element of the list.

Python-Gym adaptation: implement as print_list(lst), printing each element of lst on its own line and returning None (the function's job is the printing, like the original exercise).
hints: Use a for loop to visit every element of lst in order.
Call print() on each element inside the loop body.
The function does not need a return statement - printing is its only job, so it implicitly returns None.
expected_behavior: Prints every element of lst on its own line, in order, and returns None.
explanation: A for loop walks through lst and print() outputs each element on its own line; since nothing is returned explicitly, the function's return value is None.
